en.headline: Amber Rainstorm Warning issued; Thunderstorm Warning extended to 11 a.m.
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning at 8.40 a.m. Friday as heavy rain fell or was expected, and extended the Thunderstorm Warning until 11 a.m. with squally storms.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Amber Rainstorm Warning Signal at 8.40 a.m. on Friday. Heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour, and is likely to continue.

The Observatory said there will be flooding in some low-lying and poorly drained areas. People likely to be affected should take necessary precautions. Heavy rain may bring flash floods; the public should stay away from watercourses.

The Thunderstorm Warning, first issued earlier in the morning, remains in force until 11 a.m. Squally thunderstorms are expected over Hong Kong. Intense gusts reaching 80 kilometres per hour or above may affect the territory. Members of the public should seek safe shelter as soon as possible.

At 9 a.m. the temperature at the Observatory was 29 degrees Celsius. The forecast for the rest of Friday is mainly cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms, heavy at times at first, and a maximum temperature around 30 degrees.

zh.headline: 黃色暴雨警告生效 雷暴警告延至上午11時
zh.dek: 天文台周五上午8時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號，指本港已有或預料會有超過每小時30毫米的大雨，並將雷暴警告延長至上午11時。
body: 香港天文台於周五上午8時40分發出黃色暴雨警告信號。本港已有或預料會有大雨，雨量普遍超過每小時30毫米，並會持續。
天文台表示，部分低窪及排水較差的地區會出現水浸，市民應採取適當預防措施。大雨可能引發山洪，市民應遠離河道。
較早前發出的雷暴警告繼續生效，有效時間延長至今日上午11時，預料本港有狂風雷暴。本港或會受到時速達80公里或以上的強陣風影響，市民應盡快到安全地方躲避。
上午9時天文台氣溫為29度。今日其餘時間大致多雲，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，初時雨勢有時頗大，最高氣溫約30度。
